up: Retrieve compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4689846 with exact activity measurements (activities.standard_relation = '='). Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Join activities with assays on assay_id, filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4689846' and activities.standard_relation = '='. Join compound_structures to get canonical SMILES and molecule_dictionary to get molecule ChEMBL ID. Do not apply row limits.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4689846' AND a.standard_relation = '='
